_comment: Tiered Autonomy Configuration for Hermes Agent
_docs: default: default tier for new findings in this domain. max_tier: highest tier allowed (safety ceiling).

homelab._comment: Infrastructure can be fully autonomous — it's low-risk, high-frequency

career._comment: Career needs approval for outbound actions (emails, applications) but can auto-scan

inbox._comment: Email always needs approval — too risky for autonomous sends

calendar._comment: Calendar is informational — notify about events, conditional for prep reminders

learning.comment: Research/learning — notify about findings, propose deep-dives

self_improvement._comment: Self-improvement can auto-fix cron jobs, update configs

cross_domain._comment: Cross-domain insights always proposed — they're complex recommendations
